copy.headline: She vanished in 1982. Her father spent thousands searching for answers after her car was found at DFW Airport
copy.caption: She vanished in 1982. Her father spent thousands searching for answers after her car was found at DFW Airport. After Kathy Brownfield Goad disappeared from Fort Worth in 1982, her parents enlisted a Kentucky detective who traveled to Texas.
